summary: Per-stage local autoreview (codex gpt-5.6-sol high) to convergence, plus one whole-branch pass. CLIRUN-1-1 iterated three rounds hardening the executable-identity binding: TOCTOU (bind to verified bytes), then compatibility (run in place, no relocation), then the deadline anchor. Deep OS-level identity hardening (parent-dir chain, symlink argv0) was reclassified and deferred (D-0056) per the scope governor as outside the agent threat model. CLIRUN-1-2 and 1-3 were clean.

non_blocking_findings.summary: Full parent-directory-chain immutability + symlink argv0 preservation deferred as D-0056 (co-resident-local-attacker / exotic-launcher threat, does not affect the pilot).

residual_risks: Executable-identity binding is baseline (agent-threat-complete); deep hardening tracked in D-0056.
